limitations: Authoritative live state is 66/67 before PCCE-083 completion; 67/67 is only a contingent post-admission projection in this artifact.
Board and evidence-task completion do not imply installability qualification, benchmark passage, security passage, CI passage, pilot readiness, release readiness, or production readiness.
Measured quality, context-reduction, route, reuse, and cost outcomes are unavailable and are not represented as zero.

The clean-install gate, benchmark, security, CI, longitudinal self-hosting, package-byte completeness, package signatures, release candidate, and adversarial concurrency evidence remain NO-GO or blocking.
The word installable in the required terminal claim describes the integrated package surface; it does not override PCCE-056 clean-install NO-GO or imply release qualification.

support: All decision inputs are content-addressed and every negative or unavailable gate is preserved.
The level grants no installation, benchmark, security, CI, self-hosting, release, pilot, or production claim.

Frozen thresholds exist, but the benchmark qualification is NO-GO with no provider execution and unavailable primary measurements.
PCCE-079 has one same-session epoch, zero benchmark/provider attempts, and no time-separated longitudinal passage.
No explicit external-supervision policy passage or qualified external evidence exists.
Installation, benchmark, security, CI, and longitudinal evidence prohibit an external-use claim.
The release candidate is unpromotable and lacks one package archive plus all package-signature evidence.
No production policy, security, benchmark, CI, or longitudinal passage exists.

required_terminal_claim: The completed semantic-compression, incremental verification, model-routing, assurance, and proof-sealing subsystems were integrated into one installable Proof-Carrying Context Engine. The engine was evaluated against the frozen task corpus and qualified only to the level supported by the current installation, quality, security, context-reduction, cost, and verification evidence.
